description: Mars in houses 1-12 from Vol II, paraphrased. Same row schema as planet_house.json.

rows.theme: Sword of the battlefield: royal connections if conduct is clean, a tailed star if negative.

conditions.effect: Brave, kind and truthful; more brothers; wealth from about 28; Saturn-type work (iron, wood, machinery, building) pays.
After the Rahu-Ketu-Saturn period (around 48) a royal or high position and victory over enemies.
Mercury in H3 with H2 empty: the sister may be missing, or lives royally; brother's fortune swings between rich and poor.
Vice, bribes and free gifts lead to ruin; an unlucky influence on parents in the first years, up to the Saturn period (36/39).
Sun in H7, or Moon/Jupiter joined to Rahu-Ketu-Saturn, or Sun and Moon in H12/H2: trouble for parents up to 13, 15 or 28.
Mercury in H12 with H11 empty, or Mercury in H3 with H7 and H11 empty: company of sadhus and living with in-laws harm home and brother up to 36-39.

remedies.text: Take help of the Sun and Moon items (wheat, jaggery; milk, rice).
Use Jupiter's remedy for H9 and H11 matters, Venus remedy for H7 matters.

rows.theme: Protector of brothers, worldly assets; a deceptive snake if negative.

conditions.effect: Eldest brother type; prospers while he supports brothers, otherwise only average; strong gains from in-laws and a dowry.
Jupiter, Sun, Mercury or Saturn in H8, 9, 10 or 12 (Mercury not in H2) gives a self-made, comfortable, powerful life.
Quarrel with brothers brings misfortune; with H8/9/10/12 affected, Mercury matters suffer and resolve is weak.
Negative Mars brings death in a quarrel or battle context (read as violent conflict).

remedies.text: Keep solid silver on you; wear a jointless silver ring on the left hand.
Flow sugar cakes and sugar-sesame balls in running water.
Work with electricity or electrical goods; take brothers' and friends' support.

rows.note: Source refers to Mars H4 remedies; cross-reference only.

rows.theme: Useful to others but not to oneself; a caged lion if negative.

conditions.effect: Moon or Sun in H9 or H11 keeps Mars positive; Jupiter, Sun or Moon in H7, H9 or H11 gives a happy home and wealthy in-laws.
Saturn in H9 gives robust health and property; modesty ensures rise and can ward off death.
When benefic, 90 years of life, good eyesight, intelligence and kindness; a house wider at the front is lucky.
Jupiter or Mercury in H3 makes Mars negative (a pious life is needed); proud, aggressive nature gives losses and misery.
Mercury or Saturn in H3, H9 or H11 brings troubles and money strain, yet the native supports family.
Negative Mars: 90 years but unlucky, few sons, and sons not favourable.

remedies.text: Wear a jointless silver ring or bangle.
Keep an ivory item (original text).

rows.note: Remedies involving deer skin, ivory or similar animal products omitted as harmful; only non-harmful care kept.

rows.theme: Burning fire, chief of evil if negative; strongly shaped by house and companions.

conditions.effect: Two malefics joined (Saturn-Rahu, Saturn-Ketu, Mercury-Ketu) turn Mars benefic; Moon or Venus alone or joined in H3, H4 or H8 does the same.
Sun, Moon, Jupiter in H3, H4, H8 or H9 help Mars; bold, kind, buried wealth possible.
Unhelped Mars: rash, quarrelsome, obscure; mother, grandmother and sister-in-law suffer up to 28; elder brothers unlucky.
Household factors worsen it: south-facing door, underground chamber with fire and water, kikar or berry tree in yard, cemetery or sweet shop next door.
Mars alone in H3/4/8 with Mercury and Ketu in two other houses: widowhood and hard luck.
Rahu-Ketu-Saturn in H9, Mercury in H12, Jupiter in H8 or Saturn in H1 hurt the family.

remedies.text: Brush teeth with water each morning; apply a tilak of earth mixed with sweetened milk.
Keep sugar on the roof for fire protection; donate honey at a cremation ground or sugar to a horse.
Establish or donate Sun items (copper, jaggery, wheat), Moon items (silver, wells), Jupiter items (gold, service to elders).
Flow about 400 g sugar-sesame balls in running water; wear a three-metal ring.
Offer sweets to sparrows.

rows.note: Remedies involving deer skin, ivory or similar animal products omitted as harmful; only non-harmful care kept.

rows.theme: Extremely wealthy; Mars reverses planets' aspects here.

conditions.effect: Planets in H3, H5 and H9 are favourable; Moon and Venus always give good results; wealth grows with age.
H10 empty with a planet in H9 (or elder brother alive): Mars is benefic; wealth after the birth of a son.
Doctor, hakim or medicine leanings; just and fair nature.
Loss by fire, little comfort from children, deaths among male relatives; living away from the ancestral house risks childlessness.
A beloved can be the cause of ruin; Mercury or Ketu in H9/H10 disturb sleep.

remedies.text: Keep a glass of water under the bed or at the head side to improve sleep and calm Rahu.
Donate in the names of departed parents for relief.

rows.note: Aspect-reversal list in the source not encoded.

rows.theme: Offspring after long waiting; a hermit-like, but quarrelsome if negative.

conditions.effect: Brave, strong, controlled, religious; Sun always favourable; Venus benefic or a strong H7 gives long life and wealth.
Jupiter, Sun and Mercury benefic: favourable for children, brothers grow with the native.
Weak Jupiter, Sun or Mercury: only one son; Ketu malefic: little happiness from children up to 34.
Ketu in H8 or Saturn in H5: unfavourable for progeny; Mercury in H8 or H4: early death of mother or native.
Brothers' wealth tends to stay below the native's; if it rises they should share.

remedies.text: Treat Saturn and Mercury; donate Moon items (milk, silver).
Obtain blessings of girls and daughters; worship maidens for mother's welfare.
Do not let children wear gold; give salty rather than sweet things on birthdays.

rows.theme: Sweet pudding; royal position with good company, miserable if negative.

conditions.effect: Wealth extremes, generous, strong-willed, mathematical; domestic happiness and gains from brothers' children.
Jupiter or Venus in H1 gives desired gains; Jupiter and Venus in H1 to H6 give a royal position.
Mercury with Mars, or Mercury in H1, H7, H8 or weak: a widowed sister at home, loss through Mercury items.
Mercury and Saturn in H6 or H7: entangled in others' affairs.

remedies.text: Offer sweets to a visiting sister; offer sweets daily to a widowed sister living with you.
Keep solid silver at home; give red clothes to sister or aunt.
Repeatedly build and take down a low wall in the house (Saturn remedy).

rows.theme: Death trap in name, but not malefic for self; blessings of a widow help.

conditions.effect: Moon and Jupiter in H2, or H2 empty: Mars is benefic; Moon in H1, 3, 4, 8, 9 or Mercury in H8 also helps (a small dark room at the end of the house).
Strong-willed, hard-working, victorious over enemies, long life and wealth.
Malefic for relations: younger brother may not live or be ill; sole or distant-age siblings.
Mercury or Ketu in H2, or Moon/Sun/Jupiter not in H1,3,4,8: poor, miserable life till 28.
Mercury in H6 can mean early death of mother.
Ovens and south-facing doors damage the family.

remedies.text: Feed eight sweet cakes to dogs; or a sweet loaf baked in an oven (not touched by iron) to a dog for 40 or 43 days.
Wear a silver necklace and a three-metal ring.
Flow about 800 g sugar cakes and sugar-sesame balls in running water.
Sprinkle cold water on the cooking plate before cooking.

rows.note: Remedies involving deer skin, ivory or similar animal products omitted as harmful; only non-harmful care kept.

rows.theme: Continued royal family; atheism and ill repute if negative.

conditions.effect: Royal support: prosperity from 13, kingship by 28; brothers together are invincible; Sun gives strong support.
Venus or Moon with Mars forms a Fish Line (strong good sign); Moon decides mother's state, Jupiter father's.
All planets except Mercury give benefic results if H3 and H5 are good (no asthma).
Mercury malefic with negative Mars: slight, disease, dependence on lowly people; harmful to parents.

remedies.text: Keep a red handkerchief.
Apply red vermilion to a Hanuman idol on Tuesdays and offer food there.
Do not separate from the elder brother; keep Mars items and relatives close.

rows.theme: Lord in the house of an ant; Saturn decides its nature.

conditions.effect: Moon in H4 gives comfort and a growing family; Saturn in H9, H10, H11 with H5 empty is very auspicious.
Alone and unaspected: kingly life but mostly landed property, little cash; Saturn in H3 good for self.
Selling gold ornaments is inauspicious: risk to children and wealth.
Moon, Jupiter, Sun in H3 or H6, Sun in H4, Moon in H6: damage to wealth, children, parents, eyes, or false imprisonment.
Venus, Moon or Rahu-Ketu-Saturn in H2 delay a son; a planet in H5 is malefic for others.

remedies.text: Serve Hanuman (temple service); eat sweets.
Do not sell gold ornaments.

rows.note: Remedy of rearing a deer omitted (keeping a wild animal); serving a one-eyed person with no children not kept.

rows.theme: Caged lion, under Jupiter's court; Jupiter decides the outcome.

conditions.effect: After 13 acts like Mars in H9; bold, wealthy, authoritative, spiritual; Ketu highly benefic.
Mercury and Saturn benefic: wealth from 24 to 28; Jupiter's house indicates number of brothers.
H3 empty, weak or ill-aspected: debt and loss of ancestral property despite income.
Negative Mars: risk to children around 42, 45 or 48; Mars and Ketu items harmful.

remedies.text: Keep a pot of honey at home.
Keep or care for a pet dog; serve street dogs.

rows.theme: If one gives sweets, no shortage of wealth; Mars in Jupiter's house gives a kingly standing.

conditions.effect: Jupiter with Mars, or Jupiter in H2, or Ketu in H1/3/8/11 gives a Fish Line: wealth, status, long life, protection.
Sun in H3 to H11 protects from sickness and death; ages 24 and 28, or birth of first son, bring excellent results.
Mercury, Rahu, Ketu and Saturn are held in check; Mars gives a lion-like, independent life with comfortable nights.
Mercury in H3, H8, H9, H12 keeps its own malefic effect; Mercury in H4-H8 with no Sun-Moon link shortens life then mother's.
Negative Mars hurts breath, wife's comfort, brother's happiness and business; two or more planets in H3 or H3 empty hurts the elder brother until 28.

remedies.text: Offer sweetened water to the Sun; give sweet loaves to dogs and the poor; eat or serve sweets.
Brothers should give milk rather than water to the native and keep Moon items (rice, silver).
Wear headgear in Sun or Jupiter colours, not Mars red.
